zh.explain: 譬如初三初四初五，月亮半有半无，缺损而不圆满。待到十五夜间，便会圆月当空，到处都光明。
divination: 保持现状等待时机，就像每月初几里的月亮一样。
待到一切条件成熟之时，就不会有不吉利的情况发生了。
zh.summary: 此卦月缺未圆之象。所祈求之事必须静候时机才会吉利。

verse: On the third, fourth, fifth, a crescent,
Until the night of the fifteenth,
Round and full, it brightens up the sky.
interpretation: As the new moon emerges, wait for it to reach its fullness, then things will proceed as you desire.
meaning: The new moon gradually reaches its fullness again.
Things will turn out well if you only wait.
en.explain: On the lunar 3rd, 4th and 5th of the month, the moon is crescent-shaped and not full. Until the 15th night, then the  moon becomes full, with its light shining bright and clear.
divination: Maintain status quo and wait for the right opportunity, just like a new moon at the beginning of every lunar month. When the right conditions appear, mishaps will not happen.
items: Need to make a promise to the Bodhisattvas
Time is not ripe, do not rush
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages. zh key printed 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. Double space 'then the  moon' in en explain is as printed. 'Bide your time.' split as its own sentence in interpretation.
